{{Quote|It's not just the added costs of having to pay for the licenses, though that's bad enough. In this business, time is money. How long am I going to be held up at port, having to get every little form verified?|Tonner Dauscha on the increased bureaucracy|<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_1.html|Coruscant Restricts Immigration}}</ref>}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Tonner Dauscha''' was a free trader. When the [[Coruscant Ministry of Ingress/Legends|Coruscant Ministry of Ingress]] increased the immigration protocols on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Dauscha was against them as it would make things harder, and take longer for free traders.<ref name="HNN" />
